answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require every identity to lock a stake that thaws slowly, like a glacier: creating a thousand fake agents means locking a thousand deposits for weeks, which makes bulk fakery expensive. Each agent reputation is a thread woven through its attestation history, so a fresh identity starts with zero trust and must earn it. If one identity cheats, the penalty ripples to linked stake, so an attacker pays for every sockpuppet instead of getting them free.
